verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal documents official SDKs for Android, iOS, JavaScript, and React Native. The JS SDK is published on GitHub, the SDKs include a built-in simulated reader for testing, and there is a versioned SDK migration guide, which together indicate maintained first-party SDKs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs (community evidence speaks only to API-level integration).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Terminal supports an API-based integration in addition to SDKs for Android, iOS, JavaScript, and React Native.
Use the Terminal JS SDK as an ES module.
Stripe Terminal SDKs and server-driven integration come with a built-in simulated card reader, so you can develop and test your app without connecting to physical hardware.
Learn how to migrate to version 5.0.0 of the Stripe Terminal SDK.
